title: if you have hundreds a month to spend on ai labor
author: excellentforcongress
selftext:
you can splurge to either buy assets or hire human people to make assets here and there

there is no need to be an ai maximalist when it comes to getting your game finished, if you are spending 2, 3, 400 dollars a month or more on ai subs. there is no excuse.

if someone can only afford a simple, single subscription, like 20 a month, i can see the real budget constraints there and the desire to just have ai make some quick assets

but a lot of you are actively anti-artist in the sense of never wanting to hire people, even when you clearly can. and, maybe people with multiple max subs are the exception, but it sure SEEMS like a lot of people have multiple max or higher-tier subs from multiple companies, at which point it just seems a bit douchey to never hire any human for anything related to any assets in your games

plus, most people are subscribing to anthropic/openai, whose execs and investors have actively and openly stated that they pretty much hate all of us and view humans as an inconvenience they will get rid of the second that they can. not exactly the types of people we should be in a rush to empower. and they're willingly partnering with war criminal states, so there's that too

comments.author: Particular_Poetry885
comments.body: Unless you are paying the artists with a firm handshake AI is still better cost-effeciency wise

comments.author: johnesco
comments.body: What if you are an artist? 20 or even 100 a month isn't going to pay a coder.

comments.author: LolBanany
comments.body:
While I agree, one reason I'm trying to learn myself or move away from relying on artists is because they often flake, under deliver, over promise, miss deadlines or ghost you. I dont have time to deal with that.
Asset packs are fine but custom work is more than just a cost. Not everyone values your own time like you do.
Even reputable, higher cost artists run into problems. AI doesn't generally have this issue, which is why people will only move further away from artists as AI tech improves. It removes the unpredictable human factor and im all for it.

comments.author: CH33SYP00FSS
comments.body: Your entitlement is the EXACT reason why we don't as well. It's also the reason why I'm learning blender and maya myself as well now. I don't want any other human working on my game or thinking that they have any right to compensation or trying to push my game in the direction that they want it to go in. That's also what y'all don't understand. Look at the current state of the AAA industry and all of the different narratives that are being pushed. I'd rather get hit with an AI tag on my game then a Sweet Baby Inc., I'll tell you that much 🤣🤣😂. GTFOH!
